request.query: exact polynomial ideal membership or Groebner basis over rational numbers

matches.description: Compute a reduced Groewski basis for a bounded ideal in QQ[x_1, x_2, ..., x_n] using SymPy's exact groebner function. Returns the basis as a RationalPolynomialIdeal with the declared monomial order.
matches.title: Compute a reduced Groebner basis over QQ

matches.description: Reduce one bounded polynomial modulo a bounded ideal in QQ[x_1, x_2, ..., x_n] using a Groebner basis remainder. Returns the exact remainder and whether the polynomial is in the ideal; a computation that exceeds the enforced wall-time bound returns a typed TIMEOUT outcome instead of a remainder.
matches.title: Reduce a polynomial modulo an ideal

matches.description: Check whether a polynomial f lies in the radical sqrt(I) of the ideal I = <generators> in Q[variables], using the Rabinowitsch trick.
matches.title: Check membership in the radical of an ideal

matches.description: Compute f(A) over QQ by bounded exact Horner evaluation. The result retains the source matrix and canonical one-variable rational polynomial and independently replays the defining evaluation.
matches.title: Evaluate an exact rational polynomial at a square matrix

matches.description: Deterministic exact rational enclosure of one sparse scalar QQ polynomial on a complete axis-aligned box. It contains the full image, need not be the exact range, and containing zero does not prove a root. Bounds: 4,096 terms; degree 32768 per variable and 262144 total; 32768-digit coefficient and 32768-digit input-endpoint components; 32,768 term-axis pairs; 65,536-digit intermediate components; 32,768-digit result components; 10,485,760-byte canonical retained-source result.
matches.title: Enclose a rational polynomial on a rational box
